column4: dialect-gated: cleat#982's instrument tests, plus cleat#2205's TestTheContextFreeInsertItselfIsRefused (split out of AnInvisibleRowIsNotAMissingRow when that test switched to seeding its row via admin.Exec instead of a refused context-free insert -- see the doc comment on TestAnInvisibleRowIsNotAMissingRow). All three need a live SQL Server: two install a trigger or measure a filter-hidden row, the third proves migration 103's block predicate itself refuses a context-free write. None of the three mechanisms exists on PostgreSQL, so all three skip in this PostgreSQL-only job and RUN in test-mssql.
